name: if-only-i-had-a-brain-tooling
description: Repo-wide dev tooling (build/diagnostic scripts). The runtime app lives in server/ (own package.json) + js/ + static HTML. This manifest is dev-only and is excluded from the pages deploy.

scripts.//: BUNDLEFIX (2026-08-20) — `build` delegates to server/, where the real esbuild command lives. Both launchers (linux/start.sh step 6/7, start.bat) run `npm run build` from the REPO ROOT, and root scripts were {} — so the bundle rebuild has been failing on every single launch, printing 'ERROR: esbuild bundle build failed. The browser will run STALE code' and then continuing anyway. Found while rebuilding the bundle by hand for the gate-phase change. Delegating here fixes both launchers without editing either, and keeps server/package.json as the single source of the actual esbuild flags.
scripts.//social: social-shots is a BUILD tool that writes PNG assets — the same class as stamp-version and vox-build-bank, NOT a code/file patcher. It was removed in the 2026-08-20 script purge alongside 26 patchers and 23 stale harnesses, which it fits neither of; the playwright devDependency it needs was left in place. Restored 2026-08-25 on the operator's call, because the social cards had gone two months stale with no way to regenerate them while two docs still told you to run this command.
scripts.//docs: doc-drift-check is READ-ONLY by design — it reports and never edits a doc. It is the doc-side twin of the boot guard that refuses to start if an LLM SDK reappears: the code side had a guard and the docs did not, which is how a doc claimed a route was removed in April while that route ran in production for four more months.
scripts.//docs-prov: DOCPROV.2 — the enforcement half, wired as the Stop hook in .claude/settings.json. Exposed here as well because a Stop hook writes to stderr and stderr is easy to miss; running it by hand is the way to ask the question deliberately. Same laws as its sibling: warn-only, fail-open, exits 0 even on its own crash.
